verdict.rationale: CIPO's public site links to a page on 'Integrated circuit topography registration, fees and forms' and publishes how-to guidance on filing patent applications and maintaining patents, which suggests forms and instructions are posted on public pages. Nothing confirms that the main trademark and patent filing forms can be downloaded without logging in, and those filings are routed through online services and a MyCIPO account. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloadable trademark/patent/design forms, confirmation that forms and instructions need no account, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
